data.body:
Release RESUMED then re-PAUSED (operator request) after picking up the MCP fixes.

Since the previous pause, origin/main gained 40 commits including the fix for the linked bug
loathful-unanarchic-chickadee (c21f-6f29-5d2d-4a5a, "Stop gating op-certs on signing environment",
commit 3bde5613718c) -- claim gate no longer hard-rejects a cross-environment plan-review op-cert
when verify.require_environment is unset (this project's posture). Confirmed fixed by observing
the commit; the earlier claim of this ticket succeeded via local CLI after re-running review-plan
locally (pre-fix workaround), so no re-claim was needed.

Actions taken this session:
- Rebased worktree ../release-0.13.0 (branch release-0.13.0) onto latest origin/main (4d1567206fb4,
  "Prove the MCP request path before uvicorn serves"). Version-bump changes (pyproject.toml,
  server.json, uv.lock, CHANGELOG.md) auto-merged cleanly on top of the 40 new commits' own
  CHANGELOG entries -- new entries correctly landed under the retitled ## [0.13.0] section, with a
  fresh empty ## [Unreleased] above it.
- One of the 40 commits pinned `uv` to an exact `required-version = "==0.12.7"` in pyproject.toml
  (new `scripts/check_uv_pin.py` lint gate). Updated local uv from 0.7.18 -> 0.12.7 via the
  standalone installer, recreated .venv, re-ran `make install`.
- Re-verified after rebase + uv upgrade: `uv lock --check` exits 0; version-lockstep guard exits 0;
  `pytest tests/unit/test_release_guards.py tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py` -- 40 passed;
  `make lint` exits 0 (now includes check_uv_pin.py, check_repo_root_from_tracker.py,
  check_cli_json_js_safe.py among the gates); `make typecheck` exits 0 (687 files, up from 682).
- `make test` (full suite) was started but stopped mid-run to pause again at operator request --
  not yet completed. Will re-run to a clean finish before committing.

Nothing has been committed or pushed. No Gerrit change opened.
